There are 4 upgraded tiers of Aurora Armor: '''Hot''', '''Burning''', '''Fiery''', and '''Infernal''', which can all be obtained by prestiging the previous tier. == Obtaining == Basic Tier '''Aurora Armor''' Pieces can be obtained from [[Kuudra#Reward Chests|Paid Reward Chests]] at the end of a [[Kuudra]] fight. ;Piece Drop Chances *Basic Tier: {{Green|4.31%}} *Hot Tier: {{Green|4.2%}} *Burning Tier: {{Green|4.05%}} *Fiery Tier: {{Green|3.91%}} *Infernal Tier: {{Green|4.08%}} Higher tiers of '''Aurora Armor''' can be obtained by prestiging the previous tier at a blacksmith ({{NPCSprite|Malik}}, {{NPCSprite|Igor}}, {{NPCSprite|Alwin}}, or [[The Hex]]), which can be done if it has 10 [[Star Upgrades|Stars]] applied to it. When the player deals {{DamageType|magic}}, they gain 1 stack, with a cooldown dependent on how many pieces of '''Aurora Armor''' are worn - 1s for wearing two pieces, 0.7s for wearing three, and 0.5s when wearing all four pieces. One stack is lost after 4s of not gaining a stack. Upon reaching 10 stacks of Arcane Energy, the player is intended to be able to sneak to activate the {{AN|Homing Missiles}} ability, firing missiles that home in to targets near them, similar to the [[Flower of Truth]]'s projectiles. They have a base of {{DamageType|magic|5000}} and 0.3x ability scaling. These missiles only hit one target each; they do not deal splash damage. 3 missiles are fired if wearing Basic tier '''Aurora Armor'''; 4 if using Hot or Burning tier; and 5 if using Fiery or Infernal tier.
